metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · American Primeval
metas.description: It follows the gritty and adventurous exploration of the birth of the American West, the violent collisions of cults, religion, and men and women fighting for control of the new world.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · The Eternaut
metas.description: Follows Juan Salvo along with a group of survivors as they battle an alien threat that is under the direction of an invisible force after a horrific snowfall claims the lives of millions of people.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Devil May Cry
metas.description: When a mysterious villain threatens to open the gates of Hell, a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Last Samurai Standing
metas.description: In 1878, 292 samurai gather for a battle royale lured by a 100 thousand yen prize. Wooden tags are given; the last survivor reaching Tokyo wins. Shujiro Saga participates to save his sick family. A dangerous game of survival unfolds.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Man on Fire
metas.description: Follows John Creasy, a wounded former mercenary on a quest to get revenge for the loss of his only companion while defending the daughter of his dead colleague from the forces that tore her family apart.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Mercy for None
metas.description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death, embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Unfamiliar
metas.description: Ex-spies Simon and Meret operate a Berlin safe house until a past threat resurfaces. Now they're fleeing hitmen, Russian agents, BND, ex-lovers, and old enemies while trying to save their marriage.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · The Wonderfools
metas.description: A group of awkward townies who unexpectedly gain superpowers and fight villains threatening the peace of Haeseong city.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
metas.description: When the druid Getafix forgets how to prepare the magic potion, Asterix and Obelix must defend the village as Caesar plots to use a Gallic law against them.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Trigger
metas.description: About two men who are trying to solve a mess after firearms are suddenly widely available in South Korea, which used to be a gun-free country, through an unknown source.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · The East Palace
metas.description: A king tasks a ghost-slayer and a woman cursed to hear ghosts with uncovering a sinister presence plaguing the crown prince's palace, leading them into a dark realm.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · Nemesis
metas.description: LA crime drama pits master thief Coltrane Wilder against detective Isaiah Stiles, challenging heist genre norms while examining what drives, sustains and destroys people.
